title: SNDK Q3 FY2026 earnings beat and HBF roadmap update
body: SNDK reported revenue outperformance and earnings beat versus guidance. Management raised outlook, cited data center demand, and said HBF customer sampling and ramp milestones accelerated.

title: LITE customer agreement supports 1.6T product roadmap
body: LITE announced a customer agreement for 1.6T optical products and described roadmap launch timing. The contract strengthens revenue visibility.

title: AAOI corrected guidance statement
body: AAOI corrected a prior guidance statement and clarified that customer commitment language was preliminary, not a signed purchase order.

title: LITX conflicting claim about exposure
body: A conflicting and disputed guidance note said LITX had no relation to LITE despite issuer materials saying it provides 2x exposure to LITE.
